Comment.value: Caster Signature Gear - Damage Retyper (roadmap: Gear-to-boost-specific-mage-spells). Effect is scripted in cg_retype_inc.nss, keyed off this Tag. Deliberately not placed anywhere yet - acquisition is an open design question.

value.0:
Nine slivers of black iron strung on a wire of drawn shadow, each humming a different note of grief. The wail that empties a battlefield is wasted on things that were never truly alive; the Sorrow takes that same cry and gives it teeth. The Wail of the Banshee no longer merely commands death -- it tears at everything within its reach with the raw negative energy of the Nine's own unending mourning.

Worn at the neck. Its power sleeps for any who is not a Sorcerer.
